title: Bimodal Product Buyers
scenario: Find customers who bought products that exist in both the low and high price ranges (assuming price is determined by product_key logic).
hint: Check if customer exists in both product_key < 50 AND product_key >= 50 groups.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN product_key < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN product_key >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 10), (1, 60);
